glossEn: an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions
note: an explosive device fused to explode under specific conditions。线索：with a timer / planted a bomb。

glossEn: throw bombs at or attack with bombs
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] throw bombs at or attack with bombs。首词非 bomb，ECDICT 侧漏导，本词显式指定。线索：宾语是城市/阵地。

glossEn: an event that fails badly or is totally ineffectual
note: [WORDNET 补缺 ECDICT 未收录] an event that fails badly or is totally ineffectual。借「像炸弹一样失败」的引申义。首词是 turkey，本词显式指定。对考研零价值但是真实用法：the whole project bombed / went over like a bomb。
